.what-we-do {

/* ============================================================
   THREE AREAS
   ============================================================ */

.areas {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.area {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 285px;
  padding: 2.1rem 2rem 1.85rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05);
  transition: transform 0.24s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease, border-color 0.24s ease;
}

.area::before {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 2rem;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 4px;
  content: "";
  background: #7a2e1d;
  border-radius: 0 0 999px 999px;
}

.area:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: #d7b5ac;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.1);
}

.area-number {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;

  color: #7a2e1d;

  letter-spacing: 0.08em;

  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.area h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.85rem 0;

  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 650;

  letter-spacing: -0.025em;

  color: #171717;
}

.area p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 0.96rem;
  line-height: 1.7;

  color: #667085;
}

.area-link {
  display: inline-block;

  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 1.5rem;

  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 650;

  color: #7a2e1d !important;

  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.area-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

.feature {
  max-width: 1150px;

.feature-action {

}

<div class="mission">

<div class="mission-label">
Our Mission
</div>

<p>
The El Paso Crime Lab is an independent research organization focused on crime and public safety in the El Paso region. We produce evidence-based research that increases community capacity to diagnose, understand, and respond to criminal justice-related issues.
</p>

Understanding impaired driving in El Paso
</h2>

</p>
